messages.subject: bounds and += operator error in mean calculation
parts:
On 8/23/12 1:43 PM, dynotec wrote:> Thank you for the quick response! I ended up just restricting the entire vector to
[0,1] since I'm working with
> proportions anyway.

Well that's the right thing to do, then. It'll
keep all the values restricted to [0,1].

You might want to switch to our newer syntax, which
will go out in version 1.0. It uses named arguments
for the bounds, but is otherwise the same.

> I'm having issues using the mean function. ....

Thanks for the report. Your model should work as
written. I'll fix it and push a patch.

The key line in the error output is the following, which
says we're missing an operator+=() specialization or
have called something wrong:

...
include//stansrc/stan/math/matrix.hpp:731: error: no match for ‘operator+=’

in ‘sum += ((const std::vector<stan::agrad::var, std::allocator<stan::agrad::var> >*)v)
->std::vector<_Tp, _Alloc>::operator[]
[with _Tp = stan::agrad::var, _Alloc = std::allocator<stan::agrad::var>](i)’

- Bob
